exposure: pregnancies conceived through in vitro fertilization (IVF)/intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI)
Dichorionic-diamniotic (DCDA) twin pregnancies conceived through IVF/ICSI
finding: Women with DCDA twin pregnancies conceived through IVF/ICSI had higher risks of preeclampsia, cesarean delivery, postpartum hemorrhage, and their newborns had a slightly lower mean birth weight and required respiratory support more frequently compared to women with spontaneously conceived DCDA twin pregnancies.
mod_finding: Women with DCDA twin pregnancies conceived through IVF/ICSI had a higher risk of cesarean delivery compared to women with spontaneously conceived DCDA twin pregnancies.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was slightly lower in the IVF/ICSI group (2298 g vs. 2367 g, p = 0.005)
